findings.body:
**The secret scan treats hunk content as diff headers, so attacker-controlled lines can skip the scan.**

`secret_scan_diff` (crq.py:337-341) treats any line that starts with `+++ ` or `--- ` as a file header. It does this inside hunks too. In a unified diff, an added line whose content is `++ node_modules/x` appears as `+++ node_modules/x`. A removed SQL or Markdown line such as `-- foo` appears as `--- foo`.

Consequences:
- The scanner never checks that line.
- `path` is set to text from the line itself. If that text matches `ALLOWLIST_PATHS` (for example, it contains `node_modules/` or `dist/`), the allowlist check at crq.py:348 skips every later `+`/`-` line in the file. The skip lasts until the next `diff --git` line.
- Path-scoped denylist rules (`prx`) run against the wrong path.

This scan runs before every upload, including `secret_scan` and the merged-current `--text` patch at crq.py:1341-1343. When `gitleaks` is not installed, `gl_status` stays `not-run`. In that case nothing else catches secrets on the skipped lines, and the review uploads them.

Only accept `---`/`+++` headers after a `diff --git` line and before the first `@@` line.

<details>
<summary>🔒️ Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
     hits: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
     path = None
+    in_header = False
     for n, line in enumerate(diff.splitlines(), 1):
-        if line.startswith("+++ ") or line.startswith("--- "):
+        if line.startswith("diff --git"):
+            m = re.match(r"diff --git a/(.*) b/(.*)$", line)
+            path = m.group(2) if m else None
+            in_header = True
+            continue
+        if line.startswith("@@"):
+            in_header = False
+            continue
+        if in_header:
+            if not (line.startswith("+++ ") or line.startswith("--- ")):
+                continue
             p = line[4:]
             if p != "/dev/null":
                 path = p[2:] if p[:2] in ("a/", "b/") else p
             continue
-        if line.startswith("diff --git"):
-            m = re.match(r"diff --git a/(.*) b/(.*)$", line)
-            path = m.group(2) if m else None
-            continue
         if not line or line[0] not in "+-" or path is None:
             continue
```
</details>
findings.title: The secret scan treats hunk content as diff headers, so attacker-controlled lines can skip the scan.
